meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 安装后可让 Claude 用 Python 访问 40 多个生物信息学数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL），完成检索蛋白序列、查通路、跨库转编号、跑 BLAST 等任务。
howto.when: 当用户要在同一工作流里查多个数据库（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等）、做跨库分析或编号映射时触发。需 Python 3.9–3.12 并联网。

say.text: 帮我搜索蛋白ZAP70并获取它的FASTA序列
查化合物Geldanamycin在KEGG与ChEMBL中的编号

howto.what_en: Lets Claude use Python to access 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) for retrieving protein sequences, querying pathways, mapping IDs across databases, and running BLAST searches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to query multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) in one workflow, perform cross-database analysis, or map identifiers. Requires Python 3.9–3.12 and internet access.

say_en.text: Search for the protein ZAP70 and get its FASTA sequence.
Map UniProt ID P43403 to a KEGG ID.
Find compound Geldanamycin in KEGG and ChEMBL and cross-reference them.
say_en.note: Uses KEGG.find and UniChem for mapping.
